summary: Skills collection with bundled helper scripts using curl/ping
details: Package bundles a collection of developer 'skills' with helper scripts. Static pattern matches fire on ordinary shell/Python primitives: bundled-skills/rclone-cli/scripts/install.sh line 15 invokes `curl https://rclone.org` to fetch the rclone tool from its official project domain; bundled-skills/junta-leiloeiros/scripts/*.py and youtube-notetaker/scripts/verify.sh contain `ping`, `curl`, and HTTP GET/POST calls as part of their scraper/verification logic; loki-mode/benchmarks/run-benchmarks.sh contains an 'install' string near a curl invocation. No package lifecycle hook auto-executes these scripts on `npm install`; they run only when a user explicitly invokes the corresponding skill. Destinations observed are the official rclone.org project domain and ordinary scraper endpoints, not anonymous or attacker-controlled hosts. No credential reads, no environment scraping, no obfuscation, no fetch-and-exec of remote code, and no attacker-controlled network destination are present. The matches are keyword co-occurrence in helper scripts shipped as data alongside the skills.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
